name: bizhub-core
description: Read-only Agent host discovery and draft planning for BizHub.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect the Agent host and draft a BizHub setup plan.
interface.longDescription: Adds one read-only BizHub MCP server and one bootstrap Skill. The preview inspects only non-sensitive Agent-host facts and builds a deterministic draft plan; it does not connect to targets, deploy systems, or ingest customer data.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this host and build a BizHub draft plan.
